anomalies.description: A sustained riot involving police in riot gear and protesters on a city street, with fire, smoke, debris, and dynamic confrontations including officers advancing and objects being thrown or set ablaze.
A sudden bright flash and rapid expansion of flame and smoke at the center of the street near the police line, consistent with an incendiary device detonation (e.g., Molotov cocktail impact).

Mutual physical engagement between individuals: one person in dark clothing appears to strike or grapple with a riot officer who is crouching near a burning object; other officers nearby are actively moving into confrontation.

Escalation with multiple protesters running across a crosswalk toward or away from police lines while smoke and fire persist; a red object (possibly barricade or cart) is dragged and later set ablaze, indicating coordinated disruptive action.; A street confrontation involving a large group of people, some in dark clothing and helmets, facing off against others; a burning object (likely a barricade or debris) is on fire in the middle of the road, producing thick smoke; multiple individuals are observing or documenting with cameras while the crowd moves and tensions appear high.

Sustained violent unrest involving burning objects (e.g., a trash bin), smoke, projectiles (sparks visible at f4), and confrontation between protesters (some masked, wearing helmets) and riot police in formation with shields. The scene shows escalating tension and active clashes over multiple seconds.

A bright flash with multi-colored sparks erupts near a protester wearing a white helmet (f4), consistent with a pyrotechnic device (e.g., firework or flare) being deployed or detonated—distinct from sustained fire; it is a sudden, brief energetic release.
A sudden bright flash and debris ejection at street level, consistent with a small explosive device detonating near parked vehicles.
Sustained violent unrest: deployment of tear gas or smoke canisters, presence of riot police in formation, and individuals throwing objects or fleeing amid dense smoke and debris on a city street.
Two individuals appear engaged in physical confrontation amidst smoke; one is lunging while the other adopts a defensive/retaliatory posture, with visible motion blur suggesting active struggle.

Shattered glass and debris on the ground at a bus shelter, followed by a large crowd gathered around a damaged public advertisement kiosk with broken glass; a traffic light lies knocked over on the pavement — all indicative of collective violent unrest or property destruction during a protest.; A large crowd is gathered in an urban street setting; a damaged advertising kiosk with shattered glass is visible (frames f0–f5), followed by a downed traffic light lying on the cobblestone street (frames f6–f14), and finally a burning object near a large circular structure with people observing (frame f15). These elements indicate collective violent unrest or property destruction consistent with rioting.; A large, circular public art installation or bus shelter is on fire in the street, with flames and smoke rising; people are gathered around, some moving through the structure, indicating collective unrest or protest-related vandalism.

A sudden, intense flash and rapid expansion of fire at the base of the structure (visible in f1), consistent with a small explosive ignition (e.g., Molotov cocktail or incendiary device), preceding sustained burning.

A bus shelter is on fire with visible flames and smoke; debris is scattered on the street; a crowd is present in the background; firefighters arrive and begin extinguishing the fire starting around 183.5s.

Scene shows aftermath of violent unrest: multiple individuals lying motionless on pavement, visible blood pools, scattered personal effects and clothing, and uniformed personnel present; consistent with recent collective violent clash.

A person in full riot gear is seen bending over and interacting aggressively with a seated or crouching individual on the ground amidst scattered clothing and bloodstains; the posture and proximity suggest physical coercion or assault of a vulnerable person.

A person is crouched on the ground amidst scattered belongings while a heavily armored officer stands nearby; the posture and context suggest the individual may be helpless or subdued, though no direct physical attack is visible in these frames.

Sustained collective violent unrest: multiple groups converge, run, clash, and engage in physical altercations across the street; presence of riot gear, scattered debris, and chaotic movement indicate a riotous situation beyond peaceful protest.
Collective violent unrest involving a group clashing in the street, with chaotic movement, physical confrontations, and bystanders fleeing or observing under tense conditions.
A group of individuals is engaged in mutual physical combat in a street setting; multiple people are seen grappling, pushing, and striking each other.
A group of individuals in dark clothing engage in mutual physical combat, including grappling, pushing, and striking, near a street crossing with arched architecture in the background.
